convergenceSignals.note: FIND-1501 (iteration 15-16's finding) and its sweep-found sibling gap are both genuinely, fully resolved -- zero residual issues found on independent re-verification against the real spec text. However, this iteration's own mandated task -- independently re-derive whether the builder's iteration-16 full-spec sweep was ACTUALLY exhaustive, rather than trusting its own claim -- surfaced a FOURTH instance of the identical failure class (a pinned pure-function input sourced from real system computation/state with no named derivation/binding rule), now on REQ-202's `needsSolanaWallet({initialSkills, deployTarget})`. This is a strong signal that the recurring pattern this session (three instances found across iterations 15-16: recentSpawnAttempts, childrenProvisioning, measured_last_shelter_cost_usd) was never actually about those three specific parameters -- it is a systemic gap in how this spec documents cross-function data flow between pure functions, and a targeted per-parameter sweep bounded to 'the Purity Boundary Map's already-listed functions' can still miss an instance if the reviewer does not also check every OTHER function's own listed parameters against the SAME checklist with equal skepticism. Convergence is not yet appropriate.
